title: the Future is Coming: the Revolution of Currency

context_sources.name: Satoshi Nakamoto, Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System
N. Gregory Mankiw, Macroeconomics, ninth edition
Michael Bordo and Andrew Levin, Central Bank Digital Currency, 2017

limitations: Equation symbols are badly scrambled by the watermark and several formula lines run together.
The contents list prints replacement characters where subscripts should be.
Membership matrices and the derivative matrix are only partly legible.
The analytic hierarchy comparison matrix is never shown.
Figure 5 is cited before Figures 3 and 4, and no Figure 2 equation is numbered.

tasks: Find the factors that limit or help growth, access, security and stability at three levels
Account for countries' different needs and willingness
Decide whether a country should abandon its own currency
Design oversight for the global currency
Extend the analysis to banks, economies and international relations

section_map.summary: Five phases: cost-return, country choice, oversight, long run, testing.
Letter urging a fixed exchange rate, shared regulatory nodes and good relations.
Nakamoto epigraph, Venezuela case, five tasks.
Fixed supply, legal tender, a global central bank justified by a trust game.
Three returns, two costs, fuzzy weights, hierarchy weights, net income.
Large against small, then the impossible trinity forcing a fixed rate.
God node, national sub-nodes, personal ledger, each bounded by law.
Banking growth to zero, marginal gains ranked, zero-sum view answered.
Robust because data-free, weights subjective, country split rough.

contributions.summary: A fixed money stock turned into a deflation argument and then into a stability return.
The impossible trinity used to force a fixed exchange rate whichever currency choice is made.
A banking growth rate built to hit zero at a chosen acceptance level.

dependency_graph.handoff: The net-income result raises the question of which exchange-rate regime a country should pick
A fixed rate and free capital make the old national supervision insufficient
The net-income expressions are averaged and differentiated for the long run

assumptions.summary: The quantity of digital currency is fixed by the code.
A public body is needed because a currency is a convention about future acceptance.
Capital is mobile and monetary policy is not independent inside the system.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: No dataset is used. Robustness is claimed from that independence.

models.summary: Cost-return model with fuzzy evaluation and an analytic hierarchy.
Mundell-Fleming split of large and small countries.
Linear decay of banking growth to zero.

verification.summary: Adding or removing data is said not to move the results much.
A computer test is said to make the expression more accurate as acceptance rises.

results_trace.summary: Net income weighted 0.395, 0.595 and 0.785 across person, nation and world.
Pegging is the only workable way to hold the exchange rate.
The state's marginal gain is the largest and the person's shrinks.

writing_logic.summary: A fixed supply is pushed to its consequence, deflation, before any return is defined.
Two of three aims are spent first, so the third is forced.
Two tools are named and one is eliminated, leaving the recommendation.

language_observations.summary: The aim is quoted from its source before the paper states it.
A currency is defended as trust among strangers about the future.
Both cases are called desirable, so the system cannot lose.
A small marginal gain is read as a benefit that fades while a risk lasts.

visualization_observations.summary: Figure 1: overview of the five tasks.
Figure 2: game-theory argument for a central bank.
Figure 11: banking profit falling toward a flat line.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: Both outcomes are declared desirable, so the model cannot reject the system.
Robustness is inferred from using no data, which removes the usual test.
The banking growth rate is defined to hit zero, so the conclusion is built in.

weaknesses.summary: The hierarchy weights come from a comparison matrix that is never shown.
Several models are pure reasoning with nothing to test them against.
Equation symbols are scrambled badly enough that some formulas are recoverable only from the prose.

independent_extensions.summary: Publish the pairwise comparison matrix and recompute the weights.
Fit the decay slope to observed bank income instead of fixing it.
Replace the two-way size split with a continuous measure.

candidate_rule_impacts.summary: When two of three aims are already taken, recommend the regime the third forces.
Judge a system by net income after scoring return and cost the same way.

unresolved_questions.question: What comparison matrix produced the analytic hierarchy weights?
What value of terminal acceptance was simulated?
Where is the line between a large and a small country?
